question: What ritual actions must one perform to behold the three-eyed god?
premises: One should perform a bath by this means
One should then behold the deity
The deity is the three-eyed god
inference: Performing the prescribed bath enables one to behold the three-eyed god.
uncertainties: The referent of anena is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By this one should perform the bath and behold the three-eyed god.
